g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they are
Goal Tree (10) · Current Reality Tree (10) · Evaporating Cloud (5) · Future Reality Tree (17) ·
What must be true for us to reach the goal?
Co-initiate a conscious transformation toward a wiser, weller, regenerative civilization
People durably embody wiser views, values, practices, and ways of acting
assuming Civilizational transformation requires durable individual and collective
A transparent path connects first contact to sustained practice and contribution
Participants can repeat embodied practices at progressively deeper levels
The group learns and revises strategy through evidence, objections, and constraint review
assuming Strategy that cannot learn and revise will not sustain progress toward the goal.
Goal-relevant throughput is operationally defined without reducing transformation to
Strategic maps are governed as living, challengeable, versioned commons
Proven practices stabilize in pockets and become responsibly transmissible
assuming Durable cultural change requires transmissible pockets and institutions, not only
Contributors can develop into facilitators and accountable stewards
Dense practice containers receive sangha support and remain outward-facing
Why are we not there yet?
The group is busy while durable-adoption throughput remains low
The group lacks a disciplined practice-action-learning and constraint-review cadence
assuming Without a constraint-review cadence, activity is not reliably subordinated to
Throughput is not yet operationally defined and accepted
assuming Unclear throughput causes decisions to favor visible activity.
The group has no agreed process for validating and revising its strategic maps
assuming Without trusted map governance, a shared throughput definition remains premature
Enter adds a line · Send asks the offline guide
